fieldValues.title: Historical: the pre-RFC-032 `valueType` model
fieldValues.content: **Status: Removed** (RFC-032) — the pre-RFC-032 `valueType` enum, with its satellite properties `allowedValues`, `contentFormat`, `validationRules`, and a standalone `repeatable` cardinality, was replaced by the decomposed `fieldType` model (`datatype` × `cardinality` × value-domain × `format` × `constraints`). A Field definition carrying `valueType` does not conform to this specification.
